game.q: the old book says this old man was an expert in one thing. what?

wrong.horse: his horse literally ran off. so, no.

game.right: YES. the sign expert is the one who says, who knows?

end.line: the neighbors called every turn. the old man, an expert in signs, only said who knows.
end.l1: a horse left. horses came back.
end.l2: the old man just said: who knows?
